findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: The green shelving in the pizza dough prep double doors prep cooler was observed with accumulated soil. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured inspector that the shelving will be cleaned adequately. Ensure that these shelves are cleaned and sanitized to remove the current accumulation of soil build up, cleaned and sanitized to remove at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(B) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following were observed in disrepair.
1. There are holes along the wall above the front counter of the dish machine.
2. The coving tile near the delivery driver door is broken creating room for soil accumulation.
Ensure these location area cleaned and repaired to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The following areas were observed with an accumulation of food debris/soil:
-The inside and outside of the dish machine has encrusted food, grease, and soils.
-The green shelving above the pizza dough prep station has an accumulation of dust/grease. 
-Walk-in cooler fan cage has an accumulation of dust/debris.
-The fry station equipment where the baskets are kept including the metal rack they are set on has grease and food debris.
Ensure these areas are cleaned and sanitized to remove the current accumulation of food debris/soils and then are cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean.
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: The following areas were observed in need of repair to make the areas smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable: 
-The holes along the wall above the triple sink and near the triple sink.
-The broken floor tiles by the back door of the facility are in a state of disrepair and have food soils.
-Coving tile and the wall near the delivery driver door are in a state of disrepair.
Ensure these locations are cleaned and repaired to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface. 
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The following areas were observed with an accumulation of food debris/soils:
-The wall behind the drying rack has an accumulation of soils/food debris. 
-The drain cap for the grease trap is observed with an accumulation of food debris.
-The air vents in the kitchen are observed with dust accumulation on the adjacent ceiling tiles.
These areas need to be cleaned to remove the current accumulation of food debris/soils and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean.  
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: It was observed that the tongs that were hanging on the side of the little fryer station were observed to be visibly soiled with a hair on them. These tongs were removed from service and palced into the wash, rinse, sanitize cycle during the inspection. Ensure that food contact surfaces are clean to sight and touch.
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The green shelving that is near the dish machine is observed to be visibly soiled and is used to hang utensils after washing to dry. This shelving is being cleaned and sanitized during today’s inspection before utensil are being placed on it. Ensure this surface remains clean to sight and touch and is cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain it clean.
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: Fresh caulking is needed at the dish machine on the clean side where the metal of the table meets the wall. This fresh caulking shall be applied to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.114: The ice machine near the back door is observed to no longer be in use in the facility since the dine in area is no longer in use. This item, being unnecessary for the operation of the facility, should be removed from the facility which will allow for more thorough cleaning of the area beneath and around the machine.
6-501.114: The PREMISES shall be free of: (A) Items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment such as EQUIPMENT that is nonfunctional or no longer used; and (B) Litter

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: The air vents in the kitchen are observed to have an accumulation of dust/soil debris. Ensure that the air vents in the facility are cleaned and sanitized and then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean.
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
5-205.15: The triple sink faucet is observed to be leaking. PIC stated a work order has been placed already for its repair. Ensure the faucet is repaired by a plumber according to law so that the faucet is no longer leaking. A follow-up will take place on Monday, November 14th, 2022.
5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The smoke detector in the kitchen is observed to still be in a state of disrepair, please reference the original inspection from 4/12/2021 for the repeated violation. Ensure the smoke detector receives proper maintenance in order for it to be reconnected to the ceiling.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The dish machine table is observed to be separated from the wall without a large enough gap present to effectively clean in this area. Ensure the metal has caulking, or some other sealant in place, that allows the surface to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable, or pull the table away from the wall far enough to allow for adequate cleaning to take place.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.comment:
6-501.114: The ice machine and the CO2 tank near the back door are observed to no longer be in use in the facility since the dine in area is no longer in use. These items, being unnecessary for the operation of the facility, should be removed from the facility. 
6-501.114: The PREMISES shall be free of: (A) Items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment such as EQUIPMENT that is nonfunctional or no longer used; and (B) Litter

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: There was no hot water available at the start of the inspection. The hot water heater was not functioning properly at the start of the inspection according to the PIC due to the pilot light going out. PIC stated this is a regular issue and they have to relight the pilot light each time it happens. The hot water heater should receive proper maintenance in order for it to be functioning consistently without worry of the pilot light going out. The pilot light was lit by the PIC during the inspection and hot water was restored. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.11: (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination
occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT,
in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.
4-602.11: (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
4-903.11: Spatulas were observed to be stored between the drying rack and the wall by the dish machine. The wall
is visibly soiled and therefore is not an adequate place to wedge the utensils in for drying. Ensure that utensils, once
cleaned and sanitized, are stored in a manner that prevents contamination.
4-903.11: (A) clean FOOD-CONTACT surfaces shall be stored: in clean, dry location, not exposed to splash or other
contamination, and at least 6 inches above floor. (B) clean EQUIPMENT shall be stored in self-draining position that
allows air drying, covered or inverted.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: The storage bin of the pizza spatulas was observed to have an accumulation of debris. Ensure this is
cleaned to prevent any potential contaminants.
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude
accumulation of soil residues.

4-602.13: There is a build up of residue on the table above the wing sauce station and on the "Sealed at the Hut" sticker
dispenser. There is also an accumulation of dust on the air vents in the kitchen. Ensure each of these areas are cleaned
to prevent potential contamination.
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude
accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The following areas, but not limited to what is listed, were observed to have an accumulation of food and
other debris that requires a thorough cleaning: The floor by the ice machine, under the dish machine by the drain, by the
fryers on either side, under the green rack below the pass through from kitchen to dining room.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for
cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount
of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

6-501.11: The smoke detector on the ceiling between the pizza machine and the dish washer was observed to be
detached from the ceiling. Ensure the smoke detector is tested to ensure proper function and reattached to the ceiling.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

6-501.11: There was an observed hole on the metal of the triple sink. Ensure this hole is properly sealed in a manner
that makes it smooth, non-absorbent, and easily cleanable and that prevents food and water buildup.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

6-501.11: There was an excessive amount of food buildup in the seal of the dirty side of the dish machine where the
metal on the wall meets the metal on the table. Ensure this area is thoroughly cleaned and then seal that crack with
caulking to prevent further build up of food debris.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed
findings.comment:
8-404.11 Ceasing Operations and Reporting
(C) A permit holder shall immediately discontinue operations and notify the regulatory authority if an imminent health
hazard may exists because of an emergency such as...sewage backup...or other circumstance that may endanger
public health
findings.citation_text:
8-404.12 Resumption of Operations
If operations are discontinued as specified under 8-404.11 or otherwise according to Law, the permit holder shall obtain
approval form the regulatory authority before resuming operations.
